coder_notes: Trial enrols only IDH1-mutant glioma (grade 2/3 astrocytoma, oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma); coded not_glioblastoma per manual 1.1 note on IDH-mutant-only trials, although conditions list 'Astrocytoma, Grade IV'. Candidate fields filled for completeness. Part 2 also requires absence of 1p19q co-deletion and ATRX loss of function/expression (not coded separately); CDKN2A/B status must be documented but no particular value is required, so coded as non-selecting. Placebo listed as comparator row.
